Name: Coins
Notes: LEAGUE MONEY. `Earned In` is the MatchModes.csv id this currency is paid for - so a Quick Match never pays coins and a season match never pays marks. That separation is the whole point: "currency from wins with separate currencies per mode". Leave Earned In blank and it is paid in EVERY mode.

Name: Marsh Marks
Notes: QUICK-MATCH MONEY. Earned nowhere else, so a shelf of things priced in marks can only be bought by playing quick matches - which is how a mode gets its own reason to exist.

Name: Cup Silver
Notes: A THIRD PURSE, and the row to copy. MatchModes.csv has five ids - season, friendly, quick, cup, adventure - and a currency names ONE of them. A friendly deliberately pays no money at all: it is played for materials, and giving it a purse would make the league pointless. Nothing is priced in cup silver yet; write a Shop.csv row and it is.
